thesis: Power Artifact reduces an artifact’s activated costs by two mana, a modest-looking discount that becomes infinite mana when attached to the right monolith.

competitiveTimeline.significance: Its identity is inseparable from monolith combo, making it an early example of a cost-reduction card whose wording accidentally crosses from efficiency into infinity.

playbook.role: Assemble Power Artifact with Basalt Monolith or Grim Monolith, protect the aura from removal, and include a payoff that converts unlimited colorless mana into a win.
